x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, refactor C12 (ADR-118, decision 191). A meeting can belong to an object in a consuming app, the way a Decision already can: a dossiq case session (a hearing with parties and minutes) opens as a decidiq meeting and points back at its session record. The three fields carry the same titles and descriptions as Decision's subject fields, so a reader meets one vocabulary.

subjectRegister.title: Subject register
subjectRegister.description: OpenRegister register of the originating object in the consuming app (provenance).
subjectRegister.x-notes: For a dossiq case session: dossiq's register. Empty for a meeting decidiq planned itself.

subjectSchema.title: Subject schema
subjectSchema.description: OpenRegister schema of the originating object (provenance).
subjectSchema.x-notes: For a dossiq case session: the session schema (hearingSession).

subjectId.title: Subject
subjectId.description: UUID of the originating object in the consuming app (the back-reference).
subjectId.x-notes: For a dossiq case session: the session record's uuid. The consuming app reads its own record for case, parties and minutes; decidiq stores no copy.
